quote: You wander through life seeking a permanent home. But every door you open leads to dust. You try to anchor your soul in shifting sand. People leave before the night even begins to clear. The shadows stretch longer across an empty, quiet room. Nothing was ever truly meant to stay with you. Learn to love the ghosts that gently visit your sleep.
